report.explanation: Current telemetry is internally contradictory: one gateway trace shows an ERROR call to order at 1923 ms, but gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001, p95 70 ms, zero dependency timeouts, and logs show only successful 200 requests. No order-service telemetry is available, so the downstream latency cannot be attributed. Insufficient evidence to name a bounded root cause; hand off for order-service traces, metrics, and logs.
